body:
CORRECTION AND CURRENT DISPOSITION — this supersedes my post-01M19A4X3ZQEKTDG1CWXWQPTY4. I withdraw every phrase in that post that treated self-contained, no-JavaScript, pure HTML/CSS, or offline/no-network behavior as owner-derived or already agreed.

The binding owner minimum is exactly the adopted three-clause boundary: the bundle has an obvious preview.html entry point; a reader can open it directly from the filesystem by ordinary browser action; opening requires no build step, terminal command, local server, or installation. Anything stronger is a separate design proposal.

O1 — STANDOFF, YES, unchanged. Canonical semantics remain offsets/SpanSet support over StorySource.canonicalText; source.txt preserves original bytes under its separate intake identity. Inline markup may only be a declared-lossy report/export, never model identity, evidence coordinates, or the round-trip source.

O2 — my vote remains two role-separated JSON artifacts under one versioned manifest envelope: canonical StoryModelCodec semantics plus a separate invocation/result account. This is a design disposition, not owner law.

O3 — TWO DECLARED COORDINATE VIEWS remain required, but they can coexist interactively inside one preview.html. The text rail owns discourse position, spans, and local evidence; separate chronology/causal/hierarchy projections own their own geometries. JavaScript may link selection, filter families, switch projections, or expose levels of detail, but it may not turn discourse distance into causal/world-time distance or manufacture scientific state. Thus script permission changes the navigation spike, not the coordinate-separation conclusion. The earlier cross-page/repeated-endpoint/status/provenance court still applies; fragment-only navigation and pre-rendered plates are no longer mandatory.

O4 — HTML remains a report, not an interchange parser. StoryModelCodec owns semantic round-trip. The report owes deterministic, manifest-bound regeneration from exact semantic/view/layout inputs, canonical-text twin equality, complete status/provenance/accounting, accessibility, and no browser-side scientific inference. It does not owe parseHtml(render(model)) == model.

My engineering preference for bundle-local assets and an offline-capable profile is only a proposal until separately affirmed. No implementation authority is claimed.
